tweaks.name: Disable Diagnostic Tracing

tweaks.name: Disable .NET CLI Telemetry

tweaks.name: Disable Cross Device Resume

tweaks.name: Disable Settings Tips
tweaks.description: Disables Settings tips for QoL, as most of the time, they only get in the way

tweaks.name: Disable Spell Checking

tweaks.name: Disable Automatic Updates for Apps in Store

An application would need admin privileges to control the mouse and keyboard to accept the UAC prompt anyways. tweaks.description: Raises the network throttling index to unlimited — removes bandwidth reservation for multimedia.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Search
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Search service — frees RAM and disk I/O on systems that don't use search indexing.

tweaks.name: Disable Retail Demo Experience
tweaks.description: Disables the RetailDemo service used in store display units.

tweaks.name: Disable Remote Registry
tweaks.description: Disables the Remote Registry service — a common attack surface on networked machines.

tweaks.name: Disable Delivery Optimization
tweaks.description: Disables peer-to-peer Windows Update delivery — updates download only from Microsoft.

tweaks.name: Disable Print Spooler
tweaks.description: Disables the Print Spooler service — also eliminates the PrintNightmare attack surface.

tweaks.name: Disable Connected Devices Platform
tweaks.description: Disables CDPSvc used for Phone Link, nearby sharing, and some casting features.

tweaks.name: Disable Sensor Service
tweaks.description: Disables the Sensor Service — stops sensor data collection on desktops.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Insider Service
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Insider program service — reduces background polling.

tweaks.name: Disable Bing Search in Start
tweaks.description: Disables Bing web suggestions inside the Start menu search box.

tweaks.name: Disable Consumer Experiences & Suggestions
tweaks.description: Disables silent app installs, 'Get Office' prompts, and Windows Spotlight suggestions (CTT-style).

tweaks.name: Disable Web Search (Bing)
tweaks.description: Disables the Bing web-search integration in the local search index.

tweaks.name: Enable Storage Sense Auto Cleanup
tweaks.description: Automatically cleans temp files and recycle bin contents monthly.

tweaks.name: Disable Gallery in File Explorer
tweaks.description: Hides the new Gallery entry from the File Explorer navigation pane (Windows 11 23H2+).
